statement: Best locally observed MSA-SP-v1 integer score for eight pinned BAliBASE protein families among MAFFT L-INS-i, G-INS-i, FAMSA2 and the recorded refinements. Four cases exceed the strongest baseline score. Values certify feasible alignments under the model, not global optima or biological discovery.
status: Local pilot; author-checked, pending Douglas Colkitt review; unlisted.
scope: Full-length original BAliBASE cases in data/manifest.json; BLOSUM62, pair-projected affine gaps open 11 extension 1, terminals penalized. Separate reference-core evaluation.

assumptions.statement: BAliBASE annotated cores provide a useful but imperfect external evaluation target; agreement is not independently verified biological truth.
Eight selected protein families and small budgets do not establish broad biological superiority, DNA applicability or sustained large-scale yield.

prerequisites: Python 3.9+; standard library only for saved-result checking. External generation instructions in docs/REPRODUCE.md.
